senses.gloss:
युव युव, the actual base of the dual of the
second personal pronoun, (युवाम्, nom. acc. you two;
युवाभ्याम्, inst. dat. abl.; युवयोस्, gen. loc.;
Ved. forms युवम्, युवभ्याम्, युवोस्.)
—युव-
द्रिक्, ind., Ved. directed towards both of you.
—युव-धित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. placed or arranged
for you both; beneficial to you both, (Sāy. युवा-
भ्यां विहित.)
—युवा-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
given by both of you.
—युवा-नीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
brought by both of you.
—युवा-युज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved.
yoked for you both, harnessed by you both.
—युवा-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. belonging to both of you.

युवा युवा, f., Ved., N. of one of Agni's
arrows.

1. युवत् (for 2. युवत् see col. 3), Ved. abl. du.
of the 2nd personal pronoun, (according to Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda I. 109, 1. युवत् = युवाभ्याम्.)
—युवद्-
देवत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having (each of) you for
a divinity.

2. युवत्, Ved. = युवन्, youthful, Ṛg-veda X.
39, 8. (For 1. युवत् see col. 2.)

युवयु or युवायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. longing for
both of you, (Sāy. युवयु = युवां कामयमा-
न); intended for you both.
युवाकु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. belonging to both of you.
युवक, अस्, m. = युवन्, a youth.

युवन् युवन्, आ, युवति or युवती or यूनी, अ
(said to be fr. rt. 2. यु, but according to some for
द्युवन्, fr. 3. द्यु or rt. 2. दिव्, ‘to shine;’ com-
par. यवीयस्, q. v.; superl. यविष्ठ, q. v.), young,
youthful, juvenile, adult, arrived at puberty (applied
to men or animals); endowed with native or natural
strength, strong, excellent, good, healthy; (आ), m. a
youth, young man, a young animal; (in the Veda
युवन् is also applied to Indra, Agni, and various
other gods); the younger descendant of any one (an
elder descendant being still alive); N. of the ninth
year in Jupiter's cycle of sixty years; (युवति, इस्),
f. a girl, young woman, any youthful female, any
young female animal, (इभ-युवति, a young female
elephant; the term युवति is also applied in the
Veda to Uṣas, Night and Morning, Heaven and
Earth); turmeric; (युवती), f. = युवति, a young
woman; the sign of the zodiac Virgo; [cf. Lat.
juveni-s, jun-ior, Junius, junix: Goth. juggs:
Angl. Sax. iong, iung, geong, geogudh: Lith.
jauna-s: Slav. junu, ‘a youth;’ junosti, ‘youth.’]
—युव-खलति, इस्, इस्, इ, bald in youth; युव-
खलती, f. bald in girlhood.
—युव-गण्ड, अस्, m.
an eruption on the face of young people.
—युव-
[]
जरत्, अन्, अती, अत्, appearing old in youth, becoming
old at an early age.
—युव-जानि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved.
having a young wife.
—युव-ता, f. or युव-त्व,
अम्, n. youthfulness, youth.
—युवति-जन or यु-
वती-जन, अस्, m. a young woman.
—युवतीष्टा
(˚ति-इष्˚), f. yellow jasmine (= स्वर्ण-यूथिका).
—युव-पलित, अस्, आ (?), अम्, grey-haired in youth.
—युव-प्रत्यय, अस्, m. a suffix forming the so-
called Yuvan patronymics.
—युव-मारिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
Ved. dying in youth.
—युव-राज, अस्, m. ‘young
king,’ an heir-apparent associated with the reigning
sovereign in the government, a crown prince; epithet
of Maitreya the future Buddha; one of the Jaina
Pontiffs.
—युवराज-त्व or युव-राज्य, अम्, n.
the rank or position of an heir-apparent to a throne.
—युव-राजन्, आ, m. = युव-राज above.
—युव-
राज-शब्द-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, possessing the title of
heir-apparent.
—युव-वलिन, अस्, आ, अम्, having
wrinkles in youth or at an early age.
—युवी-भू,
cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become young.
—युवी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become young.
युवति or युवती. See under युवन्, col. 2.
युवन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. youthful, juvenile.
युवश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. young, youthful, juvenile.
युवन युवन (?), अस्, m. the moon.

युवनाश्व युवनाश्व, अस्, m., N. of the
father of Māndhātṛ; of various persons.
—युव-
नाश्व-ज, अस्, m. the son of Yuvanāśva, i. e. Mān-
dhātṛ (an early sovereign of the solar dynasty).

युवादत्त युवा-दत्त, युवायु, &c. See
under युव, col. 2.
युवाम युवाम, N. of a town.
